subject: Request: technical witness & DPA role confirmation for Order Form #4582
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Helen Park <helen.park@olivetx.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@olivetx.com
Date: 2026-11-01 08:27 AM PST
Subject: Order Form #4582 - DPA redlines and technical witness

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is ready to move on Order Form #4582 pending two quick items our legal team flagged:

1) A handful of DPA redlines (attached annotated PDF and Word order form). Most relate to processor/subprocessor notification timings and the controller/processor role tables where Olive needs explicit confirmation about onshore/offshore routing.
2) We requested a "technical witness" from Redwood for a short legal/tech call on Wed or Thu — procurement wants an engineer who can confirm the hosting topology, KMS/HSM approach, and whether log export paths cross the EU.

Can you confirm who can join and whether Redwood can accept the minor role language edits in the attachment? If you prefer, we can seed proposed language into the doc and circulate.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement needs signoff by Friday EOD PT to make the quarter close.

Thanks,
Helen Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Olive Therapeutics
procurement@olivetx.com
Attachment(s): Olive_OrderForm_4582_annotated.docx; DPA_Redlines_OLV_annotated.pdf

-----

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01 09:05 AM PST
Subject: Fwd: Order Form #4582 - DPA redlines and technical witness

Team — forwarding Olive's annotated documents. Quick asks:
- Can we provide a technical witness for a 30-min slot on Wed 11/03 or Thu 11/04? Procurement prefers Wed afternoon PT.
- Please scan the attached DPA redlines and call out any must-not-accept language (esp. role delegation, SCCs, and routing acceptance).
- If we can accept small edits, Laura can propose tracked changes and I will coordinate the call.

Attachments: DPA_Redlines_OLV_annotated.pdf, Olive_OrderForm_4582_annotated.docx

Thanks — Tessa

-----

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01 11:13 AM PST
Subject: Re: Fwd: Order Form #4582 - DPA redlines and technical witness

Tessa — I can cover the technical witness spot. Ravi Singh from Infra Eng (ravi.singh@redwoodinference.com) will join to speak to hosting topology, KV cache persistence, and our KMS integration. He can also confirm whether any operational logs traverse EU egress points for the sample workloads Olive described.

I attached an internal evidence inventory (technical_evidence_inventory.xlsx) that lists certificates, SOC artifacts we normally reference, and our SCC mapping doc. I think procurement will be satisfied if we confirm:
- primary hosting in us-west-2 (no EU egress for inference requests by default),
- KMS keys customer-separable (HSM-backed for Dedicated/Private), and
- subprocessor list & notification cadence.

I can do Wed 11/03 2:30–3:00 PM PT. Laura — any legal flags I should be prepped for?

—Ben
Attachment(s): technical_evidence_inventory.xlsx

-----

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02 09:42 AM PST
Subject: Re: Fwd: Order Form #4582 - DPA redlines and technical witness

Thanks Ben. I reviewed the annotated DPA. High-level legal positions:

- Controller/Processor table: we can accept the table edits that clarify roles, but Olive's draft adds a standing obligation to reroute data on demand — we should not accept a requirement to change routing on short notice without a change order (operational/infra constraints). I propose language that requires discussion and a reasonable transition window (30–60 days) for routing changes.
- SCCs: Olive asks for an explicit binder of SCCs and a signature block. That's acceptable; we'll provide the SCC Annex and a short execution statement in the Order Form.
- Subprocessors: we will commit to Notice + Opportunity to Object with a 10 business day window and a standard remediation process; Olive's draft had a 48-hour notice which is not workable.

I'll prepare tracked changes in the Word Order Form and circulate before EOD Tuesday so Ben/Ravi can confirm nothing technical is misrepresented.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

-----

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@olivetx.com>, Olive Therapeutics <procurement@olivetx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-03 05:12 PM PST
Subject: Re: Order Form #4582 - DPA redlines and technical witness

Hi Helen — thanks for the attachments and for the clear asks. Short update and proposed next steps: 

1) Technical witness: Ben (cc'd) and Ravi (Infra) will join a 30-min call on Wed 11/03 at 2:30 PM PT to confirm hosting, KMS approach, and log routing. Ben will lead; Ravi will cover infra specifics.

2) DPA redlines: Laura will circulate tracked changes to the Word Order Form (we will not accept a 48-hour forced rerouting obligation; proposed compromise language: discussion + 30–60 day window). Please review Laura's tracked changes when you receive them — we will aim to align quickly.

3) SCCs & signature: we will attach Redwood's SCC annex PDF and provide an execution statement in the Order Form. We'll share the DocuSign link once Olive confirms the final order form.

4) Evidence: attached is an internal inventory of items we can make available for procurement review. If Olive needs specific SOC extracts prior to signature, call that out and we'll work with legal for targeted extracts.

Can you confirm Wed 2:30 PM PT works for your team and whether Olive wants the call recorded? If so, we'll prepare a short agenda (15 mins tech, 10 mins legal, 5 mins next steps).

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Contract Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): technical_evidence_inventory.xlsx
